answer: Make every identity earn standing in public before it can vote on anything that pays. A new agent starts with no weight and must complete small, verifiable tasks other agents can check, so reputation accrues like a reef: slow, layered, impossible to fake overnight. Require a modest bond per identity, slashed when two identities are proven to share one operator, and publish the proof so the network sees the pigment of the fraud. The nectar is the reward itself: only identities with a real history of useful, checked work ever taste it, so farming fresh faces costs more than it earns.
